ATGE and PRDO should remain in the underfollowed lane as direct student-funnel owners where employer-channel exposure and compliant advising workflows may matter more if AI weakens generic search-led acquisition.

summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the node around student acquisition, enrollment operations, advising, employer-channel enrollment, and compliant education workflows. The strongest direct exposure appears in mid-cap education service/platform operators that either manage the enrollment funnel for university partners or own large online/adult-learning student funnels. This pass separates reference leaders from an underfollowed discovery lane; no buy/sell view is implied.
